entities.summary: Rafael Jose Dolis Hernandez is a Dominican professional baseball pitcher who plays for the Hanshin Tigers of the Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB). He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Chicago Cubs and Toronto Blue Jays.
